extensions.text: Wasu ne suka yi su, suna ƙara abin da za ka iya yi a nan. Kowanne yana aiki dabam da fayiloli da maɓallanka, ba tare da intanet ba, kuma yana yin abin da ka ba da izini kawai.
extensions.addText: Kowa zai iya yin ɗaya. Ana fara karanta shi kuma a nuna maka abin da yake nema, kafin a ƙara komai.
extensions.addHint: Adireshin fayil ɗinsa, ko shafinsa a GitHub.
extensions.words: Da kalmomin wanda ya yi shi
extensions.asks: Abin da za a bar shi ya yi
extensions.nothing: Babu komai: aiki kawai yake yi.
extensions.right.change: Canja abin da yake gani kafin ya ci gaba
extensions.right.refuse: Dakatar da wani aiki, ko fara tambayarka
extensions.right.loosen: Bari ayyuka su ci gaba ba tare da fara tambayarka ba
extensions.rightText.watch: Duk abin da aka rubuta a ciki, fayilolin da kake rabawa, da kowane aiki kafin a yi shi
extensions.rightText.loosen: Ba kalmar sirri ko biya ba har abada, kuma ba fiye da dokar ƙungiyarka ba
extensions.once: Buɗe sau ɗaya ba tare da wani ƙari ba
extensions.onceText: Idan wani abu bai yi daidai ba tun da ka ƙara ɗaya
extensions.error.address: Wannan ba adireshin ƙari ba ne.
extensions.error.fetch: Ba a iya karanta shi daga can ba.
extensions.error.json: Ba a iya karanta extension.json ɗinsa ba.
extensions.error.format: An yi shi don wani juyi.
extensions.error.name: Sunansa zai iya ƙunsar ƙananan haruffa, lambobi da layuka kawai.
extensions.error.main: Lambarsa dole ta zama fayil ɗin JavaScript kusa da extension.json ɗinsa.
extensions.error.rights: Yana neman abin da ƙare-ƙare ba za su iya yi ba.
extensions.error.size: Lambarsa ta yi girma da yawa.
extensions.failed: {title} bai fara ba, don haka a kashe yake yanzu.
extensions.off: {title} ya yi ta kasawa, don haka an kashe shi.
extensions.failing: Ya yi ta kasawa, don haka an kashe shi.
extensions.safe: Yanayin tsaro: babu ƙarin da zai yi aiki a wannan ziyarar.
extensions.confirmRemove: A cire {title}? Abin da ya ajiye zai tafi tare da shi.
